$doc: Corrected-observation L1 causal factorial. The superseded four-epoch decision contract could not exercise early stopping and used a fixed phase-2 LR that differed from one phase-1 LR stratum. This revision preserves the 2x2 difficulty x LR design but applies each cell's LR unchanged across BOTH phases, gives each phase a 1,000-epoch ceiling, and applies the same validation-driven patience, floor and minimum improvement in both phases. Within an LR stratum, phase1_mode is the only resolved-config difference between normal->normal and easy->normal. No preprocessing, topology, L2 or retraining-frequency genes are added.
question: With all non-difficulty facts paired, does an easy pre-training phase followed by normal fine-tuning outperform the same training and handoff procedure run normal-only, and does that effect depend on a separately declared constant learning-rate stratum?

nested_split_contract.$doc: Finding 224: the EXECUTING pipeline consumes this typed nested contract directly (nested_split_mode=l1). The role_facts below are ASSERTIONS the runner verifies against the freshly materialized per-role CSVs before any model construction — wrong path, wrong sha, wrong scored/context count, swapped role dates, a missing context declaration, context counted in score, or any sealed_test materialization refuses the cell. Authoritative values reproduced by the independent auditor 2026-08-11.

role_use.train_monitor: in-sample member of the paired comparator (2190 scored rows, 2022)
role_use.inner_validation: selection member of the paired comparator (2190 scored rows, 2023)
role_use.outer_validation: final truth ONLY — one evaluation after selection (2196 scored rows, 2024)
role_use.sealed_test: SEALED — no CSV path, hash, row load or model evaluation may be emitted (2025)

observation_contract.$doc: AUD-P1LR-20260815-235 / order 2026-08-15 §6. The accepted corrected observation contract, verbatim from the auditor-accepted L2 binding at 8189d4f9: engineered, rolling-z-scored, clipped features ONLY — include_price_window=false removes the 64 unnormalized dimensions (32 raw ETH closes, mean |value| ~1742, plus 32 raw diffs) that fixed the sign of most first-layer pre-activations, killed roughly half the actor's ReLUs from initialization and saturated the survivors into the constant terminal action -0.001271069 in BOTH learning-rate arms. The runner binds this block into EVERY cell config before any env or model is constructed (config['observation_contract']); pipeline_plugins._observation_contract applies it in phase 1 AND phase 2 and the fail-closed validator refuses an undeclared or drifted declaration before any GPU use.
observation_contract.$feature_columns: 83 ordered, deduplicated engineered columns declared by the held-fixed base config; the sha256 above pins that exact ordered list so this contract refuses to bind onto a different feature set — BOTH phases see the same ordered feature contract.
observation_contract.$observation_dimension: window_size*len(feature_columns) + include_agent_state*4 = 32*83 + 4 = 2660. The superseded price-window observation was 2724 = 2660 + 32 raw closes + 32 raw diffs; a 2724-input artifact refuses before model construction.

expected_observation.$doc: The executable dimension expectation: the runner derives window_size*feature_count+agent_state_dims from the materialized base config at every materialization and refuses drift; wrong dimensions are a hard failure.

held_fixed.$doc: Every non-factor identity field is paired. The cell LR is constant across phase 1 and phase 2; replay and optimizer reset identically at the boundary in both difficulty arms (optimizer_state_transferred=false, replay_size_at_boundary=0).

sac_training_contract.$doc: Explicitly pinned so plugin/library defaults cannot silently change the causal contrast. These values are held fixed here, not claimed optimal; later DOIN domains may optimize them.

held_fixed.handoff_viability_evidence: required on every phase-1 checkpoint (WP3 / finding 221 block)
held_fixed.topology_features_costs_protection: L1 v3 frozen system manifest contract (sha 00bfa585 family) — spread 1e-4, protected entries required, min_equity 100, financing declared-disabled
held_fixed.dates: ladder/L1 nested split contract; sealed 2025 inaccessible
held_fixed.selection: normal-realistic paired comparator on train-monitor + inner validation; outer validation truth
held_fixed.initialization_rule: every cell starts from the exact per-seed ZERO-UPDATE GENESIS artifact (typed zero_update_genesis, container- AND policy-tensor-hash-bound), NEVER a preceding cell's terminal, NEVER a trained champion or handoff, NEVER a 2,724-input legacy anchor — anchor_seed*.zip are preserved as diagnostic evidence only (order §3)
held_fixed.observation_rule: the observation_contract block above is bound into every cell before env/model construction; both phases see the same 2,660-input ordered feature contract; an undeclared or drifted declaration refuses before GPU use (finding 235)

genesis.$doc: Order §3: the clean start is a per-seed zero-update 2,660-input genesis artifact constructed deterministically under the corrected observation contract by tools/p1lr_genesis_artifacts.py: ZERO gradient updates, ZERO replay transitions (structural — the construction env cannot be stepped), policy-tensor sha256 + container sha256 recorded, determinism and save/load identity proven. All four cells of a seed begin from the ONE tensor pinned here; different seeds are pinned pairwise DISTINCT. This artifact is NEVER a trained champion or handoff. 'Independent model construction without a persisted tensor identity is insufficient.'

assignments.$doc: One seed per physical GPU; ALL FOUR cells of a seed run sequentially on that same GPU so hardware is paired within seed. Distributed anchors hash-verified on their hosts 2026-08-11.

cell_order.$doc: Deterministic cyclic Latin square: every cell occupies every within-seed position exactly once across seeds — no order/thermal confounding.

mechanics_screen.budget: one pass-equivalent per cell (1 phase-1 epoch + 1 phase-2 epoch at 20000 timesteps, matching the ladder pass budget)

budget_knobs.$doc: Executable form of the budget line above (runner WP4; the prose stays authoritative for intent). The runner refuses any values other than one pass-equivalent, and refuses an epoch_timesteps that does not match the ladder pass budget.

requires: 16/16 records with exact identities and terminal artifacts (terminal_model_path + terminal_model_sha256 mandatory — finding 223 contract)

a typed 16-entry replica proof file (tools/p1lr_collect.py, agent_multi.p1lr_replica_proof.v1) proving every terminal loads on the replica host, bound to (experiment_identity, contract_sha256, seed, cell, terminal_relative_path, terminal_model_sha256, loads=true) — the verdict REFUSES without it (finding 225)
direct handoff-viability facts on every phase-1 checkpoint (finding 221 block)
at least one trained arm not CONSTANT_POLICY and not BELOW_NORMAL_THRESHOLD before the decision budget is spent

typed actor-liveness facts on every cell record (actor_liveness_binding from the pipeline's per-checkpoint agent_multi.actor_liveness.v1 history) — an unmeasured actor or missing liveness evidence is a typed NON-PROMOTABLE outcome, never a silent pass (finding 235)
typed action-variation facts per checkpoint (constant_policy, action_raw_std) — a constant selected policy is non-promotable even when a scalar metric looks favorable

typed selected-versus-genesis facts on every cell record (selected_policy_tensor_sha256 vs genesis_policy_tensor_sha256, selected_equals_genesis boolean) — a selection that IS the genesis did not learn and is non-promotable

the live-unit FRACTION is recorded, never gated: no invented minimum (such as 256/256) may gate promotion; the hard failures are only an unmeasured actor, zero live units, constant selected behavior, wrong dimensions or missing provenance (order 2026-08-15 §7)
mechanics_screen.collapse_outcome: PHASE1_LR_REGION_COLLAPSED — stop, do not burn the full run

decision_run.$doc: Causal decision run. Every cell starts from its seed's original zero-update genesis. Each phase can train for up to 1,000 epochs of 20,000 timesteps; both phases use patience 60, floor 40 and min_delta 1e-4. The inactive-policy terminator is disabled so absence of early activity cannot pre-empt the learning question. The outer 2024 role is evaluated once after selection and sealed 2025 remains inaccessible.

budget_knobs.$doc: 1,000 phase-1 epochs + 1,000 phase-2 epochs = the 2,000 pass-equivalent per-cell ceiling. Early stopping may use less, but neither phase is a four-epoch smoke.

decision_run.truth: one final outer-validation evaluation after selection; sealed 2025 inaccessible

effective_stopping_rules.$doc: Every terminator that can end phase 2 is named. Activity stop is explicitly disabled for this experiment; a never-trading policy reaches the 1,000-epoch phase ceiling instead of being rejected around epoch 80. Phase 1 has the same patience/floor/min_delta contract and its own auditable stop summary.

replica.$doc: Order §6: a NEW replica/collection root — never a v1 collection root and never the sealed v1 collection c0e53cf18b7d60dd. tools/p1lr_collect.py stages, seals and replicates here; the replica host recomputes the tree digest and really loads all 16 terminals (finding 225).

forbidden: contracting, slicing, projecting or otherwise adapting the 2,724-input anchor_seed*.zip artifacts — they carry a learned first layer from the defective representation and are diagnostic evidence only (order §3)

reusing ANY v1 P1LR identity, output tree or record — including the sealed v1 decision collection c0e53cf18b7d60dd, which is INCONCLUSIVE and qualified INVALID_FOR_L1_RECIPE_SELECTION_OBSERVATION_CONTRACT_235
dispatching L2 against the withdrawn 'frozen normal_realistic/3e-5' v1 recipe
adding preprocessing, topology, L2 or retraining-frequency genes to this run — the only factors are phase-1 difficulty and phase-1 LR (order §6)
imposing an invented live-unit minimum (e.g. 256/256) as a performance gate (order §7)
reintroducing raw absolute closes into the observation in any form

execution_semantics.$doc: Corrections 231/232 are EXECUTABLE semantics, not documentation. They change what the selector measures and what a dead cell publishes, so they belong in the content-addressed identity: any run materialized before them is diagnostic only and can never be aggregated with a run materialized after them.
execution_semantics.causal_context_enforcement_note: role and context_rows resolve from the VERIFIED nested manifest; ContextPrefixWrapper wraps every baseline and per-epoch train_monitor/inner_validation rollout BEFORE _rollout; prefix rows force hold and are excluded from reward, action statistics, canonical traces, trades, weekly metrics and horizons; every arm reaches the score boundary at equal opening equity (finding 231)
execution_semantics.inactive_cell_semantics_note: an inactive cell publishes one immutable non-promotable record with terminal custody and a load proof, receives one diagnostic-only final outer evaluation that can never be relabeled best_checkpoint, and the seed runner continues to its remaining cells (finding 232)
execution_semantics.observation_contract_enforcement_note: finding 235: the observation contract is copied into every materialized cell config BEFORE env/model construction, applied by pipeline_plugins._observation_contract in BOTH phases, and validated fail-closed; materialization refuses feature-set or dimension drift; the initialization verifier refuses any non-2,660-input artifact
execution_semantics.selected_policy_gate_semantics_note: order §7: every cell record carries actor-liveness, action-variation and selected-vs-genesis facts; unmeasured actor, zero live units, constant selected behavior and selected_equals_genesis=true are the ONLY hard non-promotable causes; live-unit fraction is recorded, never gated

activity_classifications.$doc: Finding 232: activity classification is reported ALONGSIDE the document-38 outcome, never inside its pinned enum. Partial survival types the picture; the document-38 outcome for a partially collapsed factorial is INCONCLUSIVE with the dead cells named.

terminal_disposition_predicate.note: order 2026-08-16 item 4: the freeze/reinvestigate decision is a typed predicate evaluated from terminal records by tools/mechanics_vocabulary.evaluate_terminal_disposition; prose cannot freeze a recipe. FREEZE is only reachable from a winning terminal record with an activity-eligible checkpoint; every other outcome is REINVESTIGATE.

activity_semantics.note: audit 2026-08-16 Executed Activity Semantics: the three activity facts in ONE machine-readable object. The screen is a mechanics/custody smoke (no activity gate on dispatch); the decision run disables activity early-stopping so a never-eligible policy reaches the full epoch budget as a measured outcome; promotion REQUIRES direct activity-eligible checkpoint evidence, enforced executably in lts app/champion_succession.py stage 1b (finding 269), never merely declared.
